acceptance.item: P5-RT-08-02: Attack 12: M8 types the dimension of the 26 of F4, which has a golden value, and its decisions fragment lists it as a number with none
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/content-m8-typed-26.test.ts > m8-lie-algebras.mdx does not type it (and > m8-lie-algebras.mdx prints the dimension of that representation of F4 with <G>)
acceptance.evidence: Severity major (no adjustment). Red at base 10fe1f3: 'M8 types a golden value; expected <G k="weyl_dimension[type=F4;highest_weight=0,0,0,1].dimension"/>', Received the line-113 hit, the same as the verifier's observed value. Cause: beat 6 typed {'26'} in a brace string although weyl_dimension[type=F4;highest_weight=0,0,0,1].dimension = 26. It is now that <G>, and the M8.spec.ts allowlist entry is removed. Green: 3 passed. The M8 'numbers in prose' test passes without the entry. Commit e2a6c95.

acceptance.item: P5-RT-08-03: Attack 13: two M8 <G> paths print the right digits from the wrong record (the string through (2, 0) from the node-2 representation, and the determinant of three boards from E8 alone)
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/content-m8-golden-paths.test.ts > M8 does not print a position of the string through (2, 0) from the weights of the node-2 representation; > the determinant of the three boards of beat 6 is not printed from E8 alone
acceptance.evidence: Severity major (no adjustment). Red at base: 'the string through (2, 0) printed through a path to another representation' with Received [m8:61, m8:65], and 'three boards named, one board in the path' with Received [m8:113]. Cause: beat 1 and the b1 caption used minuscule_representations[type=A2;node=2].weights_dynkin_labels[1], and beat 6 used types.E8.det_cartan for three boards. Fix: show(STRING_TWO[1]) from the engine, and determinants from types.E8, types.F4 and types.G2. Green: 4 passed. The rendered digits are unchanged, (0, 1) and '1, 1 and 1'. Commit 5bd3c92.

acceptance.item: P5-RT-08-03 (sibling): the count of minuscule nodes of E8, F4 and G2 printed from types.E8.minuscule_nodes alone, in the same beat 6 sentence
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/content-m8-golden-paths.test.ts > the sentence of beat 6 on the boards with no minuscule node prints each golden field from every board it names
acceptance.evidence: Same cause: one board's path for a sentence about three boards. Red at base on the determinant field ('expected [E8] to equal [E8, F4, G2]'). With the clause put back by hand after the determinant fix, it is red on minuscule_nodes. Fix: the clause 'so the count above is 0' is dropped, because 'have no minuscule node' already states it. Green: 4 passed. Commit 5bd3c92.

acceptance.item: P5-RT-08-04: Attack 30 (b): M8 uses the Appendix C terms fire, population and mutate without defining or linking them (siblings: M5, M6 and M7 never link fire)

acceptance.evidence: Severity major (no adjustment). Red at base: 4 failed. M8 'fire' 7, 'population' 4 and 'mutate' 1 uses, each with 0 links. The M5 to M8 specs (127 passed) and axe pass. Commit 5ec4ee9.

acceptance.item: P5-RT-13-01: Attack 8 (P2): the answers of M8's two predictions (b1 and b5) are stated only in their reveals
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/M8.spec.ts > regressions > without JavaScript > the answers of M8 predictions b1 and b5 are stated outside their reveals, after the prediction block
acceptance.evidence: Severity major (no adjustment). Red at base: '+ b1: stated outside the reveal, after the prediction block, in: nowhere' and '+ b5: ... nowhere', the same as the script's observed value. The test uses the lens script's patterns on the built page without JavaScript. It also requires the stating text to follow its prediction block and nothing before it to match, which respects the held class P3-RT-13-01. Fix: beat 2 opens 'The first figure's two firings reach (0, −2), whose string at node 1 is that position alone.' (show(AFTER_TWO)). Seen statement 2 adds 'and from node 3 the orbit has 8 positions' (a <G> of minuscule_representations[type=D4;node=3].dimension). Words are cut elsewhere, listed in the fragment. M8 is 1795 words (dev) and 1797 (release), the same as at base. Green: 1 passed in both builds, M8.spec.ts 29 passed. The lens's rt13-p5-reveal-only.mjs on the fixed release build prints 'b1 stated in M8-q08', 'b5 stated in M8-q29', OK. Commit a7d80cd.

deviations.what: Each adopted unit reproducer keeps its tests unchanged. Two files gain one extra test each: a positive <G>-path check in content-m8-typed-26.test.ts and the every-board field check in content-m8-golden-paths.test.ts. The script reproducer of P5-RT-13-01, as a Playwright test, also asserts order: after the prediction block, and nothing before it.
deviations.why: A fix that only deleted the 26 or the clause would pass the reproducers. The order check keeps the held class P3-RT-13-01 intact.

deviations.what: Entry '26' removed. The '(-2,2)' pattern follows the new source (STRING_TWO[1] in place of the node-2 weight path). One entry added for the node label 3 of the new Seen sentence.
deviations.why: These are consequences of the fixes. The checker fails on an unused entry or an unexplained typed number. The added entry is a node label in the existing category, scoped to its own sentence.

handoff: All changed files are in the cluster: the M5 to M8 lessons, M8.spec.ts, four new site/tests/unit/content-*.test.ts files and the fragment. No T12, MatrixView or history.ts file was touched, and the ω captions of b10 to b12 (P5-RT-08-01) were left alone. No finding needs a decision. Lens rerun: the b1 answer opens beat 2 and the b5 answer sits in Seen statement 2. Both follow their prediction blocks and nothing above them states either answer (P3-RT-13-01 respected). Words were cut in beats 1, 2, 6 and 7, the E8 caption, the second sidebar and the Lie theory paragraph so that M8 stays at 1795 words (1797 in release). The list is in the fragment and the commit body of a7d80cd.
